PPI::Structure::Condition(3) User Contributed Perl Documentation PPI::Structure::Condition(3)

NAME

PPI::Structure::Condition - Round braces for boolean context conditions

SYNOPSIS

  if ( condition ) {
      ...
  }
  
  while ( condition ) {
      ...
  }

INHERITANCE

  PPI::Structure::Condition
  isa PPI::Structure
      isa PPI::Node
          isa PPI::Element

DESCRIPTION

"PPI::Structure::Condition" is the class used for all round braces that represent boolean contexts used in various conditions.

METHODS

"PPI::Structure::Condition" has no methods beyond those provided by the standard PPI::Structure, PPI::Node and PPI::Element methods.

SUPPORT

See the support section in the main module.
